metaData.title: Introducing Claude Tag
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Anthropic launches Claude Tag, a new Slack-integrated feature enabling teams to @Claude for collaborative, asynchronous task delegation with context memory and proactive capabilities.
metaData.summary: Anthropic announces Claude Tag, a new way for teams to work with Claude, starting as a Slack integration. Users can grant Claude access to selected channels and tools, then tag @Claude to delegate tasks. Claude builds context from channel activity, can take proactive initiative, works asynchronously, and supports multiplayer collaboration. At Anthropic, 65% of the product team's code is now created via an internal version of Claude Tag. The feature is available in beta for Claude Enterprise and Team customers, with tight administrative controls over tool access, data permissions, and spending limits. It works with Opus 4.8 and replaces the existing Claude in Slack app.

mainPoints.point: Claude Tag enables teams to tag @Claude in Slack channels for task delegation.
mainPoints.explanation: Claude joins as a team member, accesses selected channels and tools, and performs tasks asynchronously while building ongoing context.

mainPoints.point: It features multiplayer, contextual learning, proactive initiative, and async operation.
mainPoints.explanation: Multiple users can interact with the same Claude instance, it learns from channel history, can flag relevant info automatically, and works on tasks over hours or days.

mainPoints.point: Administrators have fine-grained control over permissions, tool access, and spending.
mainPoints.explanation: Claude's access to data and tools is scoped per channel; admins set token limits and audit logs for transparency.

mainPoints.point: At Anthropic, 65% of product team code is now generated via Claude Tag's internal version.
mainPoints.explanation: The feature is already used extensively within Anthropic beyond engineering, including product metrics, support tickets, and debugging.

keyQuotes: Tagging @Claude is now one of the main ways we get things done at Anthropic. Today, 65% of our product team's code is created by our internal version of Claude Tag.
@Claude is multiplayer. Within a given Slack channel, there's one Claude that interacts with everyone.
@Claude takes initiative. If "ambient" behavior is enabled, Claude will proactively keep you updated about whatever it thinks you might need to know.

relatedArticles.title: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5, a generally available Mythos-class model with state-of-the-art capabilities, alongside Claude Mythos 5 for trusted cybersecurity partners, with new safeguards to mitigate misuse risks.

relatedArticles.title: Introducing Claude Design by Anthropic Labs
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Anthropic Labs introduces Claude Design, a new AI-powered tool that enables users to collaboratively create and refine visual designs, prototypes, presentations, and marketing materials through conversation and direct editing.

relatedArticles.title: Introducing GPT-5.5
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI introduces GPT-5.5, a new category of AI that acts as an autonomous agent capable of planning, reasoning, and executing complex multi-step tasks across different applications.

relatedArticles.title: Best practices for computer and browser use with Claude | Claude
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides official best practices for integrating Claude's computer and browser use capabilities, focusing on screenshot scaling, resolution selection, click accuracy optimization, thinking effort tuning, and prompt injection defense.

relatedArticles.title: Higher usage limits for Claude and a compute deal with SpaceX
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Anthropic announces higher usage limits for Claude Code and API, and a new compute partnership with SpaceX to access over 300 megawatts of capacity.

relatedArticles.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.7
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Anthropic has released Claude Opus 4.7, a significant upgrade over Opus 4.6 with major improvements in advanced software engineering, vision capabilities, instruction following, and autonomous long-horizon reasoning, while implementing new cyber safeguards and maintaining the same pricing.

relatedArticles.title: Codex Now Integrates Directly with Chrome on macOS and Windows
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI introduces a new Chrome extension for Codex on macOS and Windows, enabling the AI to operate directly within a user's live browser session to perform complex, parallel automation tasks using their active profile and direct code execution.

relatedArticles.title: New in Claude Managed Agents: dreaming， outcomes， and multiagent orchestration | Claude
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Claude Managed Agents introduces dreaming for self-improving memory, outcomes for rubric-based self-correction, and multiagent orchestration for complex task delegation.

relatedArticles.title: Memory and Dreaming for Self-Learning Agents
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Anthropic introduces Memory and Dreaming, two new primitives for its Managed Agents API, enabling agents to achieve continuous self-learning by managing their own knowledge in a file system-like structure and asynchronously curating that knowledge to improve over time.

relatedArticles.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.8
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Anthropic announces Claude Opus 4.8, a new flagship model with improved benchmarks, honesty, and new features like dynamic workflows and effort control.
